svg.title: II. The three rules
svg.desc: The three rules. Master: understand what works before making my own decisions (the web developer programme completed in one month). Reinvent: when the usual solution hits its limit, try something else (my paper card game turned into an online game refereed by my own rules engine). Lead: share what I have understood so that others can move forward (20 people trained in the French team of PvZ Fusion).

text.tspan: Three verbs sum up how I work. You will find them in games, in teaching and in my projects.
Share what I have understood so
